description: Cache Status Indicator Fixes - Make the header cache indicator render on every authenticated route, hide when local-first sync or article caching is off, and show a neutral 'No items yet' state instead of a misleading green '100% cached' when there is nothing to cache. Eliminates the contradiction between the header indicator and the /settings cache section.

userStories.title: Show cache indicator on all authenticated routes
userStories.description: As a logged-in user, I want the cache status indicator visible on every authenticated page so I can monitor my cache state without navigating back to a feed.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the `isFeedReaderRoute` guard from the visibility gate in `src/client/components/cache-status.ts`
Delete the `isFeedReaderRoute` helper if it has no other callers
Indicator renders on `/`, `/starred`, `/feed/*`, `/settings`, `/about`, `/add-feed`, and any other authenticated route
Indicator does not render on unauthenticated routes (gated by `state.user.value`) — existing behavior preserved
Existing 'free / non-entitled user' hide behavior preserved
Existing 'no local DB / not bootstrapped' hide behavior preserved
No errors on routes where `state.selectedFeedId` is null (recompute logic already handles `feedId: null`)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: indicator appears on `/settings` and `/about` in addition to feed reader routes

userStories.title: Hide cache indicator when sync or article caching is off
userStories.description: As a user who has turned off local-first sync or article caching, I want the cache indicator to disappear so it doesn't falsely claim my content is cached.
acceptanceCriteria: In `src/client/components/cache-status.ts`, import `syncSubscriptions` and `storeContent` signals from `../local-first-settings.js`
Extend the visibility gate to return null when `syncSubscriptions.value` is false
Extend the visibility gate to return null when `storeContent.value` is false (even if `syncSubscriptions` is true)
Component subscribes to both signals so toggling either in `/settings` immediately updates the header without a page refresh
If sequentially setting multiple signals anywhere as part of this change, use `batch()` from `@preact/signals`
Lines stay within 80 columns
Typecheck passes
Lint passes

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: toggle off 'Sync subscriptions and read state to this device' → indicator disappears; toggle off 'Store article content locally' with sync on → indicator disappears

userStories.title: Show neutral 'No items yet' state when totalCount is 0
userStories.description: As a user with sync and article caching enabled but no items locally yet, I want a neutral indicator rather than a misleading '100% cached' so I understand there is nothing actually cached yet.
acceptanceCriteria: In `src/client/components/cache-status.ts`, split the existing `uncachedCount === 0` branch into two branches: `totalCount === 0` (neutral) and `totalCount > 0 && uncachedCount === 0` (existing green '100% cached')
Neutral state renders a gray dot and label 'No items yet'

Neutral state reuses the existing `Dot` component; if a gray color variant does not exist, add it minimally and reuse an existing CSS variable from `_variables.css` (do not introduce new color tokens unnecessarily)
Neutral state has `aria-label` such as 'Cache status: no items yet' for screen readers
Neutral state uses the same `cache-status-legend` markup as the synced state for consistent layout
Neutral state is non-interactive in v1
When `totalCount > 0 && uncachedCount === 0`, the existing green '100% cached' state still renders unchanged
When `uncachedCount > 0`, the existing yellow 'N uncached' state with action popover still renders unchanged
Update the comment in `src/client/components/cache-status-state.ts` (around lines 67-73) about 'EMPTY_SNAPSHOT' from '100% cached' to 'neutral / hidden' for accuracy
Lines stay within 80 columns
Do not change unrelated CSS
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: with sync + article cache enabled and no items yet, header shows the gray 'No items yet' state, not green '100% cached'

userStories.title: Verify header indicator and /settings agree across all states
userStories.description: As a user, I want the header indicator and the `/settings` cache section to never contradict each other so I can trust both views.
acceptanceCriteria: When `/settings` shows 'Total storage used: 0 B' with both toggles off, the header has no cache indicator at all
When `/settings` shows both toggles on with no items cached, the header shows the neutral 'No items yet' state
When `/settings` shows both toggles on with items partially cached, the header shows the yellow 'N uncached' state with action button (existing behavior)
When `/settings` shows both toggles on with all items cached, the header shows green '100% cached' (existing behavior)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: walk through all four state combinations and confirm header/settings agree in each

userStories.title: Add tests for new visibility and empty-state rules
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unit/integration tests that encode the new visibility and empty-state rules so future regressions are caught automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests in `test/cache-status.ts` cover: indicator hidden when `syncSubscriptions` is false
Tests cover: indicator hidden when `storeContent` is false (with `syncSubscriptions` true)
Tests cover: indicator shows neutral empty state when `totalCount` is 0 with both toggles on
Tests cover: indicator renders on `/settings` and `/about` routes (not just feed reader routes)
Tests cover: existing behavior preserved — yellow 'N uncached' when `uncachedCount > 0`, green '100% cached' when `totalCount > 0 && uncachedCount === 0`
`npm test` passes
`npm run lint` passes
Typecheck passes
